highlights: Give each browser profile its own proxy, or send its pages out through your own computer.
Connect Proton Pass in the Marketplace, and the browser fills the logins of its shared vault.
Type @ in a chat to give the agent one of its browser tabs or side threads.
Settings → Voice has two new local dictation models: Parakeet Unified EN and Cohere Transcribe.
Routines run in the agent's chat again. A new switch keeps a routine in its own thread.
